definitions.supplemental: O. H. Ger. chlirih: Icel. klerkr.
definitions.meaning: one of the secular (as opposed to monastic) clergy

quotations.old_english: Ic secge þé, lá cleric, on þín eáre
On gewittnesse Byrhtstánes mæssepreóstes and on clerices þe þis gewrát
Wolde ic þ-bar; þá ǽðela(n) clericas ásceócon fram heora andgites orðance ǽlce sleacnysse
Ús þingð tó langsum þ-bar; wé ealne þisne cwide on Englisc clericum geswutelion
Hé was underfange of þám hádesmannum þe him ealra uneáðest was, þ-bar; was clerican
Hé ongan tó tellende þám pápan eal embe þá clericas

source_text: clerc, cleric. Add: one of the secular (as opposed to monastic) clergy:--Ic secge þé, lá cleric, on þín eáre, Angl. viii. 300, 14. On gewittnesse Byrhtstánes mæssepreóstes and on clerices þe þis gewrát, Cht. E. 255, 30. Wolde ic þ-bar; þá ǽðela(n) clericas ásceócon fram heora andgites orðance ǽlce sleacnysse, Angl. viii. 301, 4. Ús þingð tó langsum þ-bar; wé ealne þisne cwide on Englisc clericum geswutelion, 300, 7. Hé was underfange of þám hádesmannum þe him ealra uneáðest was, þ-bar; was clerican, Chr. 995; P. 128, 20. Hé ongan tó tellende þám pápan eal embe þá clericas, P. 130, 31. [O. H. Ger. chlirih: Icel. klerkr.] v. cliroc in Dict.
